about: A model takes an observing system's measurements as its starting state (data assimilation), or a machine-learned model is trained on or started from another product. Every edge: the page that says so (`source`), when we read it (`read_utc`), whether the phrases we looked for were on it (`state`), a short quote. Stamped by tools/meteorology-read.mjs.
